annotation.title_clean: European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking (EuroHPC): European Parliament legislative resolution of 17 December 2025 on amending Council Regulation (EU) 2021/1173 (AI Gigafactories)
annotation.title_en: European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking (EuroHPC): European Parliament legislative resolution of 17 December 2025 on amending Council Regulation (EU) 2021/1173 (AI Gigafactories)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament legislative resolution approving, with amendments, the Commission proposal to amend the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking regulation. It creates an AI Gigafactory pillar and a quantum pillar, raises EU funding, and sets consortium eligibility, access-time, sovereignty/security and sustainability conditions. It concerns compute infrastructure, not robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines AI Gigafactories (over 100,000 advanced AI processors) and creates an AI Gigafactory pillar in EuroHPC.
Raises Union contribution to up to EUR 3.97 billion, with EUR 160 million ringfenced for quantum.
Restricts consortium participation by non-participating states to protect Union security and autonomy.
Sets access-time rules: free for public bodies and research, priority for SMEs, and Governing Board monitoring.
Requires annual reporting on sustainability, energy and water efficiency, and model development.
